card.line: Tyre was a rich Phoenician port city on the Mediterranean coast, a friend to David and Solomon, later warned by God, and visited by Paul.

moments.title: Hiram helps David
moments.text: Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys, cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons to David. They built a palace for him.

moments.title: Cedar for the temple
moments.text: Hiram sent envoys to Solomon, and Solomon asked for cedar to build a house for the LORD. Hiram agreed, Solomon paid with wheat and olive oil, and the two kings made a treaty.

moments.title: God speaks against Tyre
moments.text: Tyre had cheered when Jerusalem fell. The Lord GOD said He was against Tyre, and that Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon would come against it and nations would destroy its walls and towers.

moments.title: Jesus warns the cities
moments.text: Jesus said that Chorazin and Bethsaida had seen miracles that would have made Tyre and Sidon repent. He said it would be more bearable for Tyre on the day of judgment.

moments.title: Paul visits the disciples
moments.text: Paul's ship landed at Tyre to unload its cargo. Paul and his companions stayed seven days with the disciples, who prayed with them on the beach before they sailed on.
